title: NTFS resource and security-descriptor observation (v1)
description: A file-system object - a directory unless resource_kind says otherwise - together with descriptor-level facts. The ACE list alone is ambiguous: a NULL DACL (dacl_present=false) grants everyone full access, while a present-but-empty DACL grants nobody access. Those opposite meanings collapse into the same empty list unless dacl_present is reported. A resource is identified by its canonical UNC path; a local path alone is ambiguous because the server is unknown.

allOf.$comment: A NULL DACL grants everyone full access and carries no entries. A present-but-empty DACL grants nobody access; both arrive as zero ACEs, and dacl_present is the only thing that tells them apart.
boundary_reason is present exactly when is_acl_boundary is true. A boundary with no reason is a verdict with no evidence; a reason without a boundary contradicts itself.

dacl_present.description: false means a NULL DACL: everyone has full access. Always a finding.

dacl_protected.description: SE_DACL_PROTECTED: the object blocks inheritance from its parent.

ace_count.description: Number of ACEs in the DACL. Must be 0 when dacl_present is false, and must match the number of ntfs_ace observations reported for this path in the same run.

is_acl_boundary.description: The DACL differs from the parent's. A resource that blocks inheritance is by definition a boundary.

resource_kind.description: Directory unless a collector scanned files, which is opt-in. Absent means directory, which is what every contract 1.2 payload meant. Added in contract 1.3.

parent_acl_hash.description: The acl_hash of this resource's parent directory, as the same run read it. It is not the value is_acl_boundary was compared against - that is the parent's projection onto a child, which the server recomputes - but it names WHICH reading of the parent the collector judged against, which is what makes the verdict reproducible. Null at a scan root, and whenever the parent's DACL was not read in full. Added in contract 1.3.

boundary_reason.description: Why is_acl_boundary is true. Required when it is true and forbidden when it is false: a boundary with no reason is a verdict with no evidence, and a reason on a non-boundary contradicts itself. Added in contract 1.3.

acl_hash.description: Digest of the normalized DACL this resource carried when it was read, computed by the collector from the whole descriptor it had in hand. Optional and additive (contract 1.2). The server stores it as reported and independently recomputes the same digest from the ntfs_ace observations it holds; the two are reported separately so a disagreement is visible rather than resolved by fiat.
